regressionDiff.summary: Between baseline ebc2808 and HEAD 912a33d, the ENTIRE closure delta is a single file: script/ReplaceBatchNFTMinter.s.sol (+72/-7). No submodule gitlink moved (nft-staking, stable-yield-accumulator, yield-claim-nft, flax-token-v2 all unchanged), no JS step changed, no contract source changed. The user's two fixes (slippage + incomplete script) are entirely in the script.

fixA_slippage.what: Proportional BPT exit minAmountsOut was hardcoded [0,0] (unbounded) at baseline; now computed per-leg from on-chain RAW reserves and haircut by EXIT_SLIPPAGE_BPS (default 50 bps).
fixA_slippage.mechanism: Added IBalancerVaultV3.getPoolTokenInfo (+ mirrored TokenType/TokenInfo structs). Loops rawToks, computes expectedOut[i]=rawBals[i]*bptSlice/bptTotalSupply, sets minAmountsOut[i]=expectedOut*(10000-bps)/10000, require(minAmountsOut[i]>0).
fixA_slippage.note: leg-matching loop switched from getPoolTokens() to the rawToks ordering returned by getPoolTokenInfo (same order as amountsOut).

fixB_incompleteScript.what: Baseline repointed SYA.nudge and POOLER.batchMinter but did NOT restore SYA.nudgeSplit (left at the incident-zeroed 0, so the new minter would never be funded by claim()). Now restores it to 30%.
fixB_incompleteScript.mechanism: Added ISYANudge.setNudgeSplit/nudgeSplit selectors + SYA_NUDGE_SPLIT=30 constant. _repoint now calls setNudgeAddress(newMinter) THEN setNudgeSplit(30) (order load-bearing: SYA.claim reverts NudgeNotConfigured if split>0 while nudge==0).
